data.title: Past events
data.description: Every gathering since our launch at the Italian Consulate in December 2024.

items.title: RECOGNITION · Intrapreneurship Immersion Program
items.venue: Consulate General of Italy · WeWork 199 Water Street
items.detail: A five-day immersion in the New York innovation ecosystem, co-produced by Fondazione Giacomo Brodolini and I3/NYC and sponsored by Sisal / Flutter SEA. The program ran across the Consulate General of Italy and WeWork 199 Water Street, with field visits to Microsoft Garage, Cornell Tech and Newlab. It was reserved for the winning team of Sisal's internal All Innovators challenge.

items.title: October Happy Hour
items.detail: An evening with the community and with our guests from Italy. The aperitivo marked the opening day of RECOGNITION, and the visiting Italian delegation joined us; the Flutter SEA Open Innovation team introduced themselves and their mandate.

items.title: July Summer Edition
items.detail: Mid-summer aperitivo with the wider community.

items.title: European Innovation Summit
items.venue: Boffi | De Padova flagship, 5th Avenue · NY Tech Week
items.detail: Held during New York Tech Week and co-hosted with the Consulate General of Italy in New York alongside 13 European trade and innovation organizations. A live pitch session emceed by TechCrunch featured 13 European startups shaping AI and global scaling, in a room of VCs, corporate partners and leadership from NYCEDC and JPMorgan Chase.

items.title: May Aperitivo with Francesco Cerruti
items.detail: Our monthly aperitivo, hosted at Salotto.nyc, a hub for cultural research and production founded by NYC-based Italian creative professionals. The special guest was Francesco Cerruti, Managing Director of the Italian Tech Alliance, the leading association for venture capital, innovation and tech growth in Italy.

items.title: Spring Membership Meeting
items.venue: Consulate General of Italy in New York
items.detail: Our member summit welcomed the new Italian Consul General, Giuseppe Pastorelli, and unveiled the “Scaling the Bridge” 2026 Strategic Roadmap. The Innovators Panel brought Pietro Tataranni (Chief Medical Officer, PepsiCo) and Eduardo Barbaro (CDO, Tiffany & Co.) into conversation on what innovation looks like at the helm of global giants.

items.title: Italian Innovators & Alumni Gathering
items.detail: With the Regione Lombardia delegation led by On. Raffaele Cattaneo and Guido Bertolaso. Co-hosted with MAECI and the Transatlantic Harmonic Foundation.

items.title: April Happy Hour
items.detail: First aperitivo of 2026 — private room, full house.

items.title: Italian Tech Club (NYC)
items.detail: In collaboration with Italian Tech Club and the National Italian American Foundation Young Professionals Network (NIAF-YPN). Interviewed by Italian Tech Club co-founder Giuseppe di Cera, Gianluca discussed the evolving US and Italian ecosystems and addressed some of the pain points affecting the Italian, and general European, innovation economy. The conversation was very thought provoking and sparked many interesting questions from the audience.

images.alt: A speaker addressing a seated audience beside a screen showing the I3/NYC mission

items.title: Fireside Chat: Space Economy
items.detail: The event, organized in collaboration with the Italian Consulate, brought together leaders from government, industry, and investment to explore opportunities and challenges in the space economy. One of the two panels was moderated by Simone Tarantino and featured distinguished speakers, including Colonel Walter Villadei, astronaut and Italian Air Force representative on the International Space Agency and the United States.

images.alt: A panel of six speakers seated beneath a projected slide at the Italian Consulate, with a blue flight suit on display

items.title: SMAU Milano
items.detail: SMAU Milano is Italy’s leading innovation expo, bringing together startups, corporates, investors, and public institutions to exchange ideas and discover new technologies. Gianluca and Simone Tarantino were invited by SMAU's CEO and Chair to represent I3/NYC. Gianluca and Simone had the chance to meet several industry leaders, and represent I3/NYC, including in a featured international panel where Gianluca took part: “Building New Ecosystems: Driving Innovation through Partnerships”.

images.alt: A panel discussion on stage at SMAU Milano in front of a seated audience
Four attendees standing together at SMAU Milano

items.title: Gianluca Galletto at Bocconi University (Bocconi 4 Innovation)
items.detail: We were invited to present our association to current and future founders at Bocconi 4 Innovation, the university’s accelerator empowering entrepreneurs in Italy to grow their startup ideas. By the way, Bocconi University is the alma mater of three of our co-founders and board members: Gianluca Galletto, Alessandro Piol and Dario Calogero.

items.title: Co-Sponsored Event at Italian Tech Week
items.detail: At Italian Tech Week in Turin, I3/NYC co-sponsored a networking event in partnership with: Culture First Community • Nomad Pass • Fondazione Giacomo Brodolini (FGB) • LAB.BRAINdesign.

items.title: Italian Tech Week: Masterclass with Gianluca Galletto
items.detail: Held in Turin every year, Italian Tech Week is the most important tech gathering in Italy. The oversubscribed masterclass was titled “NYC, Global Innovation Hub: Access Opportunities to the US Markets and Global Growth.”

items.title: From Data to Impact: Scaling Climate Tech & Innovation through Public-Private Partnerships
items.detail: An event that convened leaders from the UNDP, Mars, Kyndryl, VCs, and climate startups to explore how we can turn climate commitments into measurable, scalable impact.

items.title: Scaling Up in the U.S.
items.detail: Joint event with Danish, Dutch, and other European partners, exploring how to successfully scale across the Atlantic, with participation from our Consulate.

items.title: The Geek of Chic · Federico Marchetti
items.detail: Chair Gianluca Galletto led an inspiring conversation with Federico Marchetti, founder of YOOX - Net-a-Porter, the first Italian unicorn, and author of the book The Geek of Chic with a foreword by Giorgio Armani. Federico Marchetti is a recognized global leader at the crossroads of fashion, technology, and sustainability. In collaboration with NIAF, National Italian American Foundation and Salotto NYC.

images.alt: Two speakers in front of a projected “The Geek of Chic” slide at Salotto, facing a seated audience

items.title: US Market Access Strategies for Italian Founders and Startups
items.detail:
Our first meetup, designed to equip Italian founders with practical insights on how to navigate and succeed in the US venture and innovation landscape. Under the leadership of Simone Tarantino, the event combined expert guidance, peer networking, and shared experiences, continuing to strengthen the I3/NYC community and its mission to empower Italian innovation in New York: the seed of our growing community spirit.

We were joined by the founders of four Italian startups who shared their successful journey in the US in a panel expertly led by Simone:

Cloud4Wi, a company that delivers automatic and secure WiFi access, and unleashes innovative location-aware experiences, serving large retailers, public space operators, transportation companies and more.

Diode Computers, which applies AI to design and manufacture circuit boards for advanced industrial applications.

Almanax, a digital solutions firm that uses AI agents to reason like engineers, and automates the detection, triaging, and patching of code vulnerabilities.

Scalestack AI, an artificial intelligence startup building scalable AI-driven tools and platforms to help organizations automate workflows and extract insights from data.

images.alt: A speaker presenting to a full room at Impact Hub
Five participants standing together in front of the Impact Hub sign

items.title: European Tech Night
items.detail: In partnership with 15 European innovation organizations (French Tech, Digital Irish, Nordic Chambers, and more). Over 400 attendees, including 70% VCs and C-level executives, 32 presenting startups, and participation of Consuls General from all participating countries. An unforgettable night of cross-border collaboration, and a legendary afterparty in a historic house from the American Revolution times in SoHo.

items.title: GovTech Forum
items.detail: I3/NYC Chair Gianluca Galletto gave a keynote speech on the transformation of NYC into the second largest innovation ecosystem in the world, which provided an excellent opportunity to present I3/NYC to an audience of smart cities and govtech entrepreneurs, government leaders, and CTOs.

items.title: Lazio Region Program
items.detail:
A flagship institutional initiative bringing a high-level delegation from Lazio (Rome’s Capital Region) to New York, including President Francesco Rocca, senior regional officials, and executives from leading Italian companies such as Aeroporti di Roma, Almaviva, Alfa Sigma, Angelini Industries, Farmindustria, and many more, including 20 excellent startup founders selected by Lazio Innova, the innovation agency of Lazio’s Regional Government.

The program convened 200+ participants across corporates, startups, investors, and public institutions, and featured three thematic industry roundtables, startup pitch sessions and three networking convenings with VCs, entrepreneurs, and industry leaders (including Mike Pell, Director of Microsoft Garage in NYC and the inventor of PDF and Acrobat), and a special session at Cornell Tech.

Meetings and dialogues were held with leadership from Empire State Development (NY State Secretary of Economic Development), the Brooklyn Navy Yard (CEO and Chair), New Lab (Co-Founder & CEO), Civic Hall, and NYC Economic Development Corporation, strengthening transatlantic ties across innovation, industry, and public policy. This event reinforced our credibility with public institutions and major players in the New York innovation ecosystem.

items.title: Official Launch at the Italian Consulate in New York
items.venue: Consulate General of Italy in New York
items.detail: A milestone celebration attended by leading figures from the U.S. and Italian innovation ecosystems, marking I3/NYC’s official debut. Hosted by the Consul General of Italy in New York Fabrizio Di Michele and Deputy Consul General Marta Mammana, our Executive Chair Gianluca Galletto, who presented the initiative, and our co-founders were joined by Julie Samuels, President & CEO of Tech:NYC, Jonathan Schulhof, EVP for Innovation Industries at the NYC Economic Development Corporation, and Denise Felipe Adams, Executive Director for Innovation at the NYC Mayor’s Office.

images.alt: Group photo of co-founders and guests at the Italian Consulate in New York
